title: Quick games
summary: A minute's play over words already met, outside today's lessons, that never moves a schedule.
description: Play for a spare minute, over what the lessons taught. Matching visible cards is recognition, not recall, so games never count as reviews.

stories.as: a learner with a spare minute
stories.want: a quick game over words I have met
stories.soThat: I practise without starting a lesson or disturbing my schedule

requirements.text: Match pairs, Flip and match, the dictation game and Say it draw only on words and sentences the learner has already met; Sound pairs uses the app's built-in pairs.
Match pairs uses up to 8 Polish and English pairs against the clock, and Flip and match up to 6 pairs counted in moves; each needs at least 4 words met.
The dictation game and Say it use up to 5 sentences each and need at least 3 met; Sound pairs plays 8 rounds.
A finished game pays `game.xp`, up to `game.xp-per-day` from games a day.
Playing a game writes no review: no word's or lesson's next check-in moves.
Game XP is listed in the day's XP under the game's own name.
The best result of Match pairs (fastest time) and of Flip and match (fewest moves) is kept and synced between devices; the other games keep no record.
A game played after the day's game XP is used up still counts as having practised that day.

values.description: What a finished quick game pays.
The most quick games pay in a day.
